column2: Slow gentle push-in through an empty, newly built warehouse hall with steel trusses, a large skylight and metal shelving racks; soft daylight, perfectly static architecture.

Slow gentle dolly forward in a newly built warehouse hall toward stacked wooden pallets; two workers in hard hats stand talking with subtle natural movement; daylight from the skylight; architecture unchanged.
Slow smooth lateral camera glide along the light brick facade of a modern two-storey business unit on a sunny day; leaves move gently in the breeze; building shape, windows and materials unchanged.

Slow gentle push-in toward a modern light brick business building with large office windows on a sunny afternoon; a pedestrian walks naturally along the pavement; trees sway slightly; architecture unchanged.
Slow gentle push-in at dusk toward an open overhead door of a modern business unit, a white delivery van with headlights on waits in front of the lit warehouse; architecture unchanged.

Slow smooth camera glide at dusk along the warmly lit office windows on the upper and lower floor of a modern light brick business unit; a person walks to the entrance; clouds drift slowly; architecture unchanged.

Slow gentle push-in in a bright modern meeting room above a business unit; people at the table move subtly and naturally while a presenter gestures at the screen; sunlight through the large windows; room layout unchanged.
Slow smooth dolly through a bright modern office floor with desks, monitors and plants; employees work with subtle natural movement; daylight through large windows; room layout unchanged.
